versions.changelog: Fix playback failure on clients that request a very high bitrate (e.g. Jellyfin Desktop on a fast LAN): declare the real source video bitrate so Jellyfin caps the transcode target at a few Mbps instead of hundreds. libsvtav1 rejects anything over 100 Mbps, which made the HLS transcode return HTTP 500 and the player fail to open the stream.
Fix playback on all clients: the media source id now matches the id Jellyfin advertises while browsing, so PlaybackInfo no longer returns NoCompatibleStream
Fix playback: use a filesystem-safe media source id so Jellyfin's FFmpeg direct-stream/remux step no longer fails with an invalid log path
Proxy playback through Jellyfin so the CDN gets a browser User-Agent; fix sidebar/browser page; 10.10.7 rebuild
